subject.title: [Bug]: memsearch-summarize sub-session compaction fails with "No API provider registered for api: ollama" on 2026.7.1, while main-session compaction with the same provider succeeds

question: Should the current-main compaction fix ship only in the next normal release, or should its exact minimal commit set be backported to a v2026.7.x correction release?
rationale: Current main resolves the bug, but choosing release cadence and accepting a backport require release-owner intent after the exact fix SHA and dependency set are established.

options.title: Next normal release
options.body: Identify and verify the fix SHA, document its inclusion, and ship it with the next scheduled release because the released failure is bounded and non-fatal.

options.title: Backport to v2026.7.x
options.body: Cherry-pick the smallest proven fix and regression test into a correction release if degraded memory summaries warrant faster stable-channel recovery.

recommendation.title: Next normal release
recommendation.body: Identify and verify the fix SHA, document its inclusion, and ship it with the next scheduled release because the released failure is bounded and non-fatal.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history connects this person to agent-harness architecture and release-adjacent work, making them the best routing candidate for release inclusion.
